name: Pushover
description: Send push notifications to your devices via Pushover: messages, priorities, emergency receipts, glances and sounds.

settings.label: Application API token
settings.help: Token of your Pushover application (pushover.net → Your Applications).

settings.label: Default user/group key
settings.help: Your 30-char user key (or a delivery group key). Used when a tool call omits 'user'.

settings.label: Default device
settings.help: Optional device name to target by default (blank = all devices).

settings.label: Default sound
settings.help: Optional default sound name, e.g. pushover, magic, none.
